item.tib: gsas mkhar zhi ba g.yung drung yongs rdzogs bsgrub thabs kyi dkyil 'khor
item.coloph: de nas dkyil 'khor zhal bsgyur la / khro bo dbang chen drag po sku rdzogs bskyed pa'i bsgrub pa bya'o / gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs thig le dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor / gsas 'khor dbyings kyi phrin las zhes bya ba rdzogs so / dang ra khyung rdzong nas rma ston srol 'dzin gyis gter nas gdan drangs nas / bri ston nyi ma rgyal mtshan la brgyud / de nas me gnyos rnam gnyis bcas rim par brgyud nas bdag la'o
item.note: contains unnumbered chapter divisions. the colophon says that the treasure text was transmitted to bri-ston nyi-ma rgyal-mtshan, and from him by degrees by way of both me and gnyos down to 'myself.' this text is listed in brgyud rim, p. 234: yang gter bdag gis lung bstan nas / rma ston gyis dwang ra khyung rdzong nas zhi ba g.yung drung yongs rdzogs (here it is listed as a subsidiary text to the gsang ba bsen thub).

item.tib: gsas mkhar zhi ba g.yung drung yongs rdzogs pa'i gzhung
